title: Unit – 1 : Session – 10 : SLO – 2  |  NAND gate and universal implementation
sections: 2. B — It can implement AND, OR, NOT
1. NAND gate — c) Output is 0 only when all inputs are 1
2. NAND as NOT — a) Connect both inputs together
3. NAND as AND — e) Invert NAND output → (A·B)'' = A·B
4. NAND as OR — b) De Morgan: A + B = (A'·B')'
5. Universal Gate — d) Any logic function can be built using it
2. NAND as NOT: tie both inputs together → Y = (A·A)' = A̅. Truth table: 0→1, 1→0.
3. OR using only NAND gates: invert A → A', invert B → B' (two NANDs as NOTs), then NAND the results: (A'·B')' = A + B. Total 3 NAND gates.
